formulas.name: Logic family parameters
notes: Where: I<sub>OH</sub>, I<sub>OL</sub> = output currents, I<sub>IH</sub>, I<sub>IL</sub> = input currents (high, low); V<sub>OH</sub>, V<sub>IH</sub>, V<sub>IL</sub>, V<sub>OL</sub> = voltage levels; NM = noise margin
Tip: DTL: slow; TTL: 10 ns, fan-out 10; ECL: fastest, non-saturating; CMOS: lowest static power.

formulas.name: CMOS dynamic power
notes: Where: C = load capacitance (F), V<sub>DD</sub> = supply (V), f = switching frequency (Hz)
Tip: Power rises with frequency; halving V<sub>DD</sub> cuts power to ¼.

notes: Tip: Address lines n → 2<sup>n</sup> locations. 1K × 8 needs 10 address, 8 data lines.

formulas.name: Combinational design steps
notes: Tip: Examples: adders, subtractors, MUX, decoders, encoders, comparators, code converters.

formulas.name: Sequential design steps
notes: Tip: Mealy output depends on state + input; Moore on state only.

formulas.name: Shift registers
f: n-bit register delays by n clocks
notes: Tip: Ring counter (n states), Johnson counter (2n states) are shift registers with feedback.
